note: What the Boat Module and the Trailer Module hold and the old seed dropped, carried by each row’s own Source cell from the old repository’s extracts (tools/seed/bands.ts). BESIDE the rows and not yet columns on them: as columns they would be read by Review’s checks, by the price list editor’s layout and — the trailer features name boats — by the fitment reading of every text column of a trailer, each a decision for the screen that owns it. Printing them on a quote is the owner’s call (docs/research/proposal/analysis.md §7 question 10).

bands.name: Deposit schedule
bands.says: The DEPOSIT PAYMENT SCHEDULE band (Boat Module!QC..QH): the share of the price due at this stage, as the workbook holds it (0.2 is 20%).

bands.name: Factory lead times
bands.says: The Factory Lead Times (in Days) band (Boat Module!QJ..QO): days, as the workbook holds them.

bands.name: Trailer features
bands.says: The TRAILER FEATURES band (Trailer Module!Q..AL), as the workbook writes it.
